title: Stocks Rise on AI Confidence; Tensions Mount in the Middle East | Bloomberg Brief 08/17/2026
summary: The dollar falls to a three-month low as the latest economic data further ease bets on Fed rate hikes. The 60-day deadline of the US-Iran MOU expires and Tehran says it has lost "all relevance" because of the violations from the US. Ella Gude of BNY Investments Newton discusses the Fed's rate path. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bonds Sell Off After India Closes Window for Dollar Swaps Early

title: Trump Issues Threat to Oman as US-Iran MOU Expires
summary: President Donald Trump threatened to bomb Oman if it gets in the way of developments with Iran, according to reports from Fox News. A 60-day truce between the US and Iran— already repeatedly violated — will expire on Monday without a deal on how the Stair of Hormuz should be managed. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Consumer Resilience Starting to Show Cracks, Says RBC’s Calvasina
summary: Lori Calvasina, head of US equity strategies at RBC, examines US consumer resilience ahead of retail earnings this week and explains why she doesn’t see any impediments to the buy America trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Seeks to ‘Substantially Reduce’ US-South Korea Drills
summary: President Donald Trump told the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” joint military exercises with South Korea. In a social post on Sunday, Trump indicated his frustration that the US ally hadn’t provided more support for his war with Iran as a 10-day joint exercise involving some 18,000 South Korean troops was scheduled to begin. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Emerging Currencies Rise to Fresh Record on Fading Fed Hike Bets
summary: An index tracking developing-nations’ currencies rose to a fresh record as cooling bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike boosted risk appetite, while equities extended their rally on demand for technology shares.

title: Ankur Crawford on the Power of Mistakes

They also discuss her journey from engineering to investment, along with understanding AI and compute investment cycles.  (Source: Bloomberg)
